name: Eran
overview: Eran was a male member of the tribe of Ephraim, identified specifically as the son of Shuthelah. He is noted in Scripture in connection with the Eranites, a family or clan named after him. His mention is brief but serves to establish a genealogical line within the tribe of Ephraim.
namesAndTitles: The name Eran means 'watcher' or 'watchful' in Hebrew, reflecting a proper name that was not specifically given by God. This meaning may imply vigilance or attentiveness, characteristics valued in the biblical context, though the text does not elaborate further.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Eran as the son of Shuthelah. Beyond this, no additional family relationships are detailed in the biblical text provided. This direct filial connection situates Eran within the Ephraimite lineage.
scriptureSignificance: Eran's significance lies primarily in his place within the genealogical records of Israel, particularly the tribe of Ephraim. The naming of the Eranites after him indicates that he was the progenitor of a distinct family group, contributing to the tribal organization that God established among His people. His mention underscores the importance of lineage and tribal identity in the biblical narrative.
